label: dependency drill down
prompt:
Inspect the implemented codebase and extract detailed dependency data for the selected item: "{{parent-node}}".

Locate the code corresponding to selected label.

If selected item represents a module, package, or subsystem, extract its internal dependencies, direct consumers, shared dependencies, and verified cycles.

If selected item represents a dependency relationship, trace how that dependency is established through imports, construction, injection, configuration, or runtime integration.

Keep scope centered on selected item. Use consistent abstraction level. Include only dependencies verified in implementation.

Set data type to dependency. Assign stable semantic identifiers to nodes and edges. Mark items as non-drillable only when further inspection would not be useful.

Return only semantic JSON data required by appended diagram-data contract. Do not generate SVG, HTML, Mermaid, styling, or visual layout. Let application calculate positions, sizes, and connector routes.
